metadata.description: carveout: hand one part of a closed TypeScript repository to a contractor, and check an agent's change in the repository.

plugins.name: carveout
plugins.description: Hand one part of a closed TypeScript repository to a contractor and take a checked patch back; check what a change reaches and whether it weakened a test. Optional hosted mode: after sign-in, a bundled MCP server works with the person's workspace on the Lunox platform (platform.lunox.work).
